title: Martin's axiom: existing foundations
existing_coverage_and_exact_fact: [Branches and antichains](entries/infinite-trees/entry.html#branches-and-antichains) fix the tree notions; [Aronszajn existence](entries/infinite-trees/entry.html#aronszajn-existence) gives a tree with countable levels and no uncountable branch; [diagonal club intersection](entries/clubs-and-stationary-sets/entry.html#diagonal-intersection) and [Fodor's lemma](entries/pressing-down-and-delta-systems/entry.html#fodors-lemma) supply the ordinal combinatorics. [The diamond construction](entries/diamond-and-suslin-trees/entry.html#diamond-tree-construction) supplies a Suslin tree under its stated assumption.
remaining_scope_to_develop: Develop the forcing framework and prove the Martin's axiom application. An Aronszajn tree need not be Suslin.
